title: Dashboard savings collection and Vault iron providers
subtitle: RTK command-output savings and Headroom input savings have separate scopes

items.label: RTK collector
items.desc: Share pending collection; cache successful results for 60 seconds

items.label: History collector
items.desc: Independent of routing; eight-second timeout; share pending collection

items.label: Dashboard API
items.desc: Unavailable history is null; measured empty history is an empty array

items.label: Savings display
items.desc: Unavailable measurements show an em dash; measured zero stays zero

items.label: Vault UI
items.desc: Iron mode: provider presets (Cloudflare, OpenAI, Anthropic, custom) fill env name, hosts, paths, prefix

items.label: Vault guard
items.desc: Validates provider spec, adds provider via iron, stores key; 502 if iron down

items.label: Iron client
items.desc: Own SSH key, no multiplexing; status / set / token / provider-add / ca-pem

items.label: Backup job
items.desc: 30 s debounce, detached iron backup, status file, retry API

items.label: Egress refresh
items.desc: Trust iron CA, append new hosts, run egress-pin

items.label: iron-vault-api
items.desc: Accepts only status, set, token, provider-add (JSON on stdin), ca-pem

items.label: iron-key credstore
items.desc: Holds real keys and provider rules; hands workspace only a proxy token
